title: Setting a Scene
grammar: Scene-setting time words (akkoriban, korábban) and amikor for a whole era
goal: I can open a story by naming when and where it happened.
I can describe the background situation using akkoriban and korábban.
I can use amikor to frame a whole stretch of background time, not just one moment.
I can use four new scene-setting words.
